dominant_strengths: Clear typographic hierarchy with readable event titles and time indicators
Functional time-blocking layout efficiently displays concurrent and sequential events
Weather and location context integrated naturally into header area
dominant_weaknesses: Color palette creates muddy visual hierarchy - saturated blocks on dark background blur together
No visual breathing room between events creates cognitive overload and scanning difficulty
Generic card-based treatment lacks calendar-specific visual language or innovation
fix_priorities: Implement subtle color system with reduced saturation and better contrast ratios
Add 8-16px spacing between events and group by morning/afternoon/evening
Create distinct visual treatment for all-day items vs timed events
Develop unique calendar metaphor beyond generic colored rectangles
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral design (functional scheduling) undermined by weak visceral appeal (muddy colors) and mediocre reflective value (generic aesthetics).
rationale.intent_fit: Successfully displays calendar information but fails to elevate beyond basic functionality into a distinctive, pleasurable scheduling experience.
